answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. What survives to the island is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the harbor of a task receipt, and the yarrow is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, published publicly on failure, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain.
